method:
equiv_orthos(mult): exact DFS over <mult>-orbits of Z21 assigning orbit images so f(mult*x)=mult*f(x),
f bijective, f-id bijective, f(0)=0; classes = min over R1 orbit (gen_three_trades_c21v1.orbit: A, I, unit conjugation)
and point translations T_e f(x)=f(x+e)-f(e); known = 6 baseline + 50 trade classes + 2 linear classes, all omitted.
scope: DMs containing a row triple (0,id,f) with f equivariant under x->2x, 4x or 8x (up to proved R1+translation equivalence), completions unrestricted
